item.assassin.assassin_twin_blades.descr: A pair of blades. The Assassin Medallion is required to awaken the class.
item.assassin.assassin_medallion.descrip: Use to awaken the Assassin class and unlock its skill tree.
skill.assassin.swift_step.title: Agility
skill.assassin.swift_step.description: Gain movement speed for each Agility rank.
skill.assassin.shadow_step.title: Shadow Step
skill.assassin.shadow_step.description: Teleport behind a target up to 100 blocks away.
skill.assassin.shadow_twin.title: Shadow Echo
skill.assassin.shadow_twin.description: Separate ability (R): teleport behind the target while two shadow clones attack.
skill.assassin.shadow_veil.title: Shadow Veil
skill.assassin.shadow_veil.description: Become invisible. Duration and cooldown scale with rank.
skill.assassin.veil_double.title: Mirror Image
skill.assassin.veil_double.description: Shadow Veil leaves a wandering decoy in your place.
skill.assassin.mirage.title: Mirage
skill.assassin.mirage.description: Create a distracting illusion swarm. Cooldown is five times its duration.
skill.assassin.rapid_assault.title: Whirlwind
skill.assassin.rapid_assault.description: Attack speed ×10 and damage per hit ×0.1 for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
skill.assassin.evasion.title: Evasion
skill.assassin.evasion.description: Gain a 1% dodge chance per rank.
skill.assassin.shadow_echo_hit.title: From the Shadows
skill.assassin.shadow_echo_hit.descripti: Gain a 1% chance per rank to summon one shadow clone that repeats your attack.
skill.assassin.perfect_dodge.title: Perfect Dodge
skill.assassin.perfect_dodge.description: Ability (B): dodge all incoming damage for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
skill.assassin.sprinting.title: Shinbreaker Sprint
skill.assassin.sprinting.description: Gain 35% movement speed for 3 seconds. Cooldown decreases with rank.
skill.assassin.quiet_step.title: Silent Step
skill.assassin.backstep.title: Backstep
skill.assassin.decoy.title: Decoy
skill.assassin.decoy.description: Backstep leaves a wandering illusion at your starting point.
